QUOTE: Defining it before the headers are included makes `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expand to the real name `x`, so those translation units read and write fields directly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without the define the macro expands to `private_##member` (so ordinary consumers see renamed members), and with it the macro expands to the plain name. Both views are covered.
